concepts.reader_question: Dữ liệu qua rồi: ai xác nhận tiếp?
concepts.description: Two physically distinct integration workstations with an open handoff path and unconfirmed receiving boundary. Use credible semiconductor material depth and integrated neutral diagrams. All background records blank; no microglyphs, data, IDs, dates, metrics, ticks, seals, fabricated results or added labels. Print only exact approved artwork and official mark once.
